title: Dr. Kristen Durbin and Beto Nelson Wed in Moab, Utah
html:
Dr. Kristen Durbin, a child and adolescent psychiatrist who practices in Salt Lake City, Utah and daughter of Renee Pappas and Mike Durbin, married Beto Nelson on September 26, 2026. The wedding that included 170 guests was in beautiful Moab, Utah in the La Sal Mountains, where the groom was born and raised.

L to R: Peter Durbin (bride's brother), Casey Macdonald (bride's SIL), Beto Nelson, Kristen Durbin, Renee Pappas, and Mike Durbin
